meta.thesis: SoftTech is a ~3-decade-old, founder-led vertical software product company for the architecture-engineering-construction-and-operations (AECO) domain, anchored by a dominant building-permit automation franchise. FY26 was an inflection: maiden conference call, and several marquee wins (Airport Authority of India CivitINFRA, BMC Civit TDR exchange, Mitsubishi/L&T CivitSUSTAIN water project).
